name: Summer☆Salt ~Misao Shojo Soushitsu Hen~
original_name: さまぁ☆ソルト～美紗緒・処女喪失編～
source: A single mother and her daughter living in a rural town are targeted by a male landowner who seeks to have a child and continue his bloodline. The man convinces the young and impressionable daughter, Misao, to bear his child in the future, and the mother is forced to comply. As time passes, the mother regrets her decision and begs the man to forget their agreement, but Misao is already caught in his trap. The story explores the manipulative tactics of the man and the sacrifices made by both the mother and daughter out of love for each other.
translation: 一对住在乡间小镇的单亲母女，被一名企图生下孩子、延续血脉的男性地主盯上。他说服年幼而易受影响的女儿美纱绪，答应将来替他生孩子，母亲也被迫同意。随着时间流逝，母亲后悔当初的决定，恳求男人忘掉约定，可美纱绪早已落入他的圈套。故事探讨了男人操纵他人的手段，以及母女二人出于对彼此的爱所做出的牺牲。
